instruction: Set up my Ubuntu desktop to show notification banners.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to enable notification banners when they are initially disabled. The config sets show-banners to false (Do Not Disturb mode), and the agent must enable it back to true. The evaluator uses the existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter to verify the gsettings value is 'true\n'. This is the inverse operation of the original task, maintaining similar difficulty and interaction pattern.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings command returns 'true\n' or 'false\n' with newline character. Used existing exact_match metric which compares strings directly.
